# proxmox_cluster_mapping (Data Source)

Reads one cluster hardware mapping of type `pci`, `usb` or `dir` from `/cluster/mapping/{kind}/{id}`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "proxmox_cluster_mapping" "share" {
  kind = "dir"
  id   = proxmox_cluster_mapping_dir.share.id
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `id` (String) Mapping identifier.
- `kind` (String) Mapping type: `pci`, `usb` or `dir`.

### Read-Only

- `description` (String)
- `live_migration_capable` (Boolean)
- `map` (List of String) Raw Proxmox property strings such as `node=pve-1,path=/srv/share`.
